}

datasource db {

  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")

  id         String     @id @default(cuid())
  tenantId   String
  url        String
  secret     String
  maxRetries Int        @default(3)

  disabledAt DateTime?
  disabledReason String?
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime   @updatedAt
  deliveries Delivery[]

  @@index([tenantId])
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
  output   = "../src/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Endpoint {
  id         String     @id @default(cuid())
  tenantId   String
  url        String
  secret     String
  maxRetries Int        @default(3)
  signingVersion Int    @default(1)
  disabledAt DateTime?
  disabledReason String?
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime   @updatedAt
  deliveries Delivery[]

  @@index([tenantId])
}

model Delivery {
  id            String         @id @default(cuid())
  endpointId    String
  endpoint      Endpoint       @relation(fields: [endpointId], references: [id])
  eventType     String
  payload       Json
  status        DeliveryStatus @default(PENDING)
  attempts      Int            @default(0)
  lastError     String?
  nextAttemptAt DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime       @updatedAt

  @@index([endpointId, createdAt])
  @@index([endpointId, status])
  @@index([status, nextAttemptAt])
}

enum DeliveryStatus {
  PENDING
  SUCCEEDED
  FAILED
  DEAD
}

content.text:
Added `Endpoint.lastDeliveredAt`.

- Schema + migration `20261102150300_endpoint_last_delivered_at` (nullable `TIMESTAMP(3)`).
- Worker sets it after a successful delivery (`deliver.ts`).
- `GET /v1/endpoints/:id` already returns all non-secret columns; added a test that it includes `lastDeliveredAt`.

Typecheck and unit tests pass (after regenerating the Prisma client). The integration tests couldn't run here - Postgres and Redis aren't reachable in this environment - so those are unverified.
